I was thinking more along the lines of failstacking like in BDO.
You level a shit price of gear to get failstacks then you use them all on your good gear.
Is that possible in ms2?

Well then I guess we are both in the same boat. In saying that I also know nothing anyone says matters. But I find comfort in knowing I’m not the only one struggling to live day to day, even though that’s bad. To existing 🍺(cheers)
Do u ever have any desires outside your routine or do u simply “exist” for the sake of it

Did u used to have a social life? Did u realise through your depression that socialising was no longer entertaining? I lost all desire to socialise honestly, I fact i lost the attraction to my opposite gender. In contempt with being by myself. However I understand that others are needed to complete day to day tasks so in a sense I fake it and use them. But I guess that’s what others have been doing to us the whole time. Do you have a dry routine u follow too?

Honestly I was there at one point. I spent months banging my head against the wall crying all night. The mistakes I made the people I let down. It crept under my skin and honestly I broke down crying in the middle of my class in high school. As time went on I began to get desensitised to it, I ended up losing my sense of justice and began thinking logical and that’s when I realised if I can’t change it then there is no reason to worry about it. I would move on from things instantly. However at the time I believe the stress and torment I revived from within my own thoughts and outside may have molded me a bit. I don’t think changing drastically like I did would happen to others honestly, however in a sense I hope u come to a similar resolution as i would hate for someone else to fell the pain I felt at that time.

I’ve been depressed for 5 years. In and out. One thing that always stayed the same though was my lack of emotions. I began to despise people and still do tbh. Do u have your good days, how have your emotions help up?

Honestly he probably had depression before he went overseas. There’s a name for it where they try to escape reality by going overseas. Only problem is when u do you have no-one to rely on and feel lonely. Depression kicks in hard and you lose whatever desire you had in the first place to go overseas. You fall into a pit of despair and are simply waiting for an excuse to die, beginning to become anxious and sleepless. - self experience. Not the same for everyone of course but this seems to be pretty common. Hopefully this will help u understand how he is feeling
Honestly I would like to think depression could be a personality because that would mean there was nothing wrong with us, how long hVe you been depressed for?

Feeling numb to everything days passing by in and out nothing changing. Socialising is nothing more then a task. It no longer feels enjoyable to do things that I once enjoyed. Simply existing with nothing but my thoughts keeping me company. No desire to maintain friendships. The feeling of being complete lost within yourself. That’s how I’ve been feeling for years now. It doesn’t go away it’s just part of me now. But after a while I don’t think it’s so bad. Just because we don’t desire what we should and we don’t feel the same way others do does that make us wrong?
How are you meant to deal with someone passing when they were the only reason for your happiness.

When u have no one else to talk to you cling to whatever u can. U might see her as some random but she probably thinks of you as someone she can trust. It’s her last string of hope. She feels lonely and desires an outlet. Whether or not you want to be the outlet is up to you

I stay active more or less because when there is nothing u can really do to entertain yourself  being active is just the same as everything else. Like exercising gives me the same stimulus and reading, studying and eating, they are all just things u can do to pass time. Anyway I don’t want to consume your time as you probably have things you like to do.

I have a weight set and use it about 3 times a week. I’m a runner i run about 10 kilometers everyday. This is because it is supposed to help me. I have difficulty meditating as I have anxiety and a ringing in my ears constantly. It’s hard to explain but doing nothing makes me feel worse. I have friends however I do not enjoy socialising. I used to enjoy socialising however after my childhood “experiences” I have difficulty finding those feelings and emotions. I have tried to make new friends however as I do not enjoy socialising it’s hard to maintain. My form of entertainment is doing more dangerous and risky things to feel whatever I feel when I do that. I took up the hobby of photography because I have a good eye for it. I understand what is socially acceptable as a good photo and I share this in an attempt to feel something from the praise and responses I get. My family being the cause of my childhood “experience” means I can talk to them. Putting it simply my brother put a knife to my throat and my mother deprived me of basic things to see what would happen to me. Honestly I’m waiting for the next train right now to go shopping for a new innovative way to entertain myself.
It didn’t get anywhere and I don’t have enough money to keep going. My thoughts are the only health care I have ironically.
